h1. maven-build-pipeline — GitHub Actions graph

{toc:minLevel=2|maxLevel=3}

{info:title=How to read this page}
Left-to-right job graph as on a GitHub *workflow run* page. Boxes use the job {{name:}} from {{workflow.yml}}. {status:colour=Green|title=success} = {{if:}} true; {status:colour=Grey|title=skipped} = {{if:}} false — GitHub still *draws* skipped jobs.

*12 jobs* in the reusable workflow. Columns are longest-path ranks from {{needs:}}. Diagrams below show *next-column* edges only (readable). GitHub also waits on earlier jobs — see *Full needs: wait edges* at the bottom for the fan-in (especially into {{notification-email}}).

Open one expand for the scenario you care about. There is no live dropdown in wiki markup.
{info}

h2. Legend

{status:colour=Green|title=success} job would run &nbsp;&nbsp; {status:colour=Grey|title=skipped} job would skip (still shown on the GitHub graph)

h2. Scenario: develop push · single-module

{expand:title=develop push · single-module (10 run / 2 skip)}
Typical service/UI snapshot: Nexus Maven artifacts + image. Multi-module and release skip.

|| Run || Skip ||
| 10 | 2 ({{multi-module-artifacts}}, {{release-artifact}}) |

|| 1 || 2 || 3 || 4 || 5 || 6 || 7 || 8 ||

{status:colour=Green|title=owasp} | {status:colour=Green|title=sonarqube} | {status:colour=Green|title=read-maven-pom} | {status:colour=Green|title=sonarqube-gate} | {status:colour=Grey|title=multi-module-artifacts}\\
{status:colour=Green|title=nexus-maven-artifacts}\\

h2. What GitHub shows in each column

Same left-to-right order GitHub uses (longest dependency path). Parallel jobs share a column.

|| Column || Jobs ({{name:}}) || Typical skip ||
| 1 | {{build-preprocess}} | Never (entry job) |
| 2 | {{build-and-unit-test}} · {{owasp}} | Stage flags / {{skip_owasp}} |
| 3 | {{sonarqube}} | Branch vs PR args inside the same job (like ng-ui) |
| 4 | {{read-maven-pom}} | If preprocess or both Sonar jobs fail |
| 5 | {{sonarqube-gate}} | {{skip_sonar}} or {{skip_quality_gate_check}} |
| 6 | {{multi-module-artifacts}} · {{nexus-maven-artifacts}} · {{release-artifact}} | POM shape, snapshot vs release stage, PR |
| 7 | {{docker-build}} | PR, missing docker stage, or a needed artifact job failed |
| 8 | {{notification-email}} | Only when {{skip_notification}} is true |

h2. Full needs: wait edges

GitHub {{needs:}} is *not* only the next column. Every job after preprocess also waits on preprocess; {{notification-email}} waits on almost everything. Use this diagram when you need the real wait fan-in. Node colours below are the *develop · single-module* skip set.
